designPillars: Bedrock: multiple characters playable in the same game world without breaking anything. Every mod is screened for player-bound state (player-alias scripts, quest variables keyed to the player, per-character needs/skill/appearance state) and must tolerate character switching.
Scale: 1000-2000 plugins; replace vanilla content broadly with diverse, quality, high-performance assets; prefer rule-driven systems (KID/BOS/SkyPatcher) that absorb asset churn.
Survival: comprehensive and in-depth with zero tedium, no save restrictions.

female.why: Full body+face set (diffuse/normal/specular/subsurface), ships vanilla, UNP and CBBE UV variants so it does not force the body-mesh decision, explicit Community Shaders subsurface support, covers elderly and Afflicted.
female.note: 4K and 2K variants both in archive; user does not need 4K.

male.why: Scratch-made 2025 textures for all non-beast male races, true to vanilla style, options for body hair, age and dirt.

beast.open: Flawn’s Vanilla Argonians Redux (43389) remains the vanilla-faithful alternative if the real-animal patterns clash with Reverie/SkySight.

rejected.BnP family: User judged male skins clearly worse than SkySight and female not preferable. Kept as fallback only.
rejected.Racial Skin Variance (81668): Diffuses come from the BnP family and the archive is CBBE-centric body-shape variance (Normal Maps/CBBE/Big Breasts), not race authenticity.
rejected.Simply Skin (98131/107637): Strong lore-friendly match but vanilla-UV only, which would lock the body mesh to vanilla.

skinAndBody.fallback: If Reverie or SkySight disappoint in game, revisit BnP Female (65274) and Simply Skin (98131 female / 107637 male).
skinAndBody.constraint: Skin textures come in three incompatible UV families (vanilla, UNP, CBBE); the skin choice and body-mesh choice are one decision. Reverie covers all three.
